leadText:
Fairchild Island (Japanese: デカポン島 Dekapon Island) is an island in the Orange Islands. It appeared in Bound for Trouble.

Fairchild Island is a mixture of forested and rocky terrain. suspected that the island's and reached to their current gargantuan sizes because of Fairchild Island's fruit-filled forests. There are many resident wild Pokémon that will attack anyone who makes their way onto the island.
